items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Orchard Cabaret? No. With Papa Celeste and Big(Archie?) >> [INTERVIEWEE] Orchard, Orchard Archie, Archie's Cabaret.

ctx.x: Orchard Cabaret? No. With Papa Celeste and Big(Archie?)
And then I heard Louis was in town and I went and hired Louis Armstrong and I hired Johnny Sincere and St. Cyr Yudell Wilson.
